blocks.title: Clearly Canadian’s revenue, 1998 to 2007
blocks.subtitle: Total revenues, $ millions, as first printed in each annual report (1998 to 2001 from the report for 2002). Not one accounting basis; see the data notes.

points.text: The report for 2002 prints 20.477. The report for 2003 restates 2002 to 20.205 for discontinued operations.[^6][^15]
The report for 2006 restates 2005 to 8.712 and 2004 to 11.064, below the first-reported 9.141 and 11.586, and nets sales incentives against sales from then on.[^18]
Revenue rose to 10.263 from 7.462. The company bought DMR Food Corporation, a snack maker, in February 2007, so the total is not a drink figure.[^19][^34]

blocks.source: Annual reports to the SEC for 2002 to 2007.[^6][^15][^16][^17][^18][^19]
